question: Can wrapping the Nix builder exec under `hermit run` determinize a non-reproducible Nix build? Prototype the execBuilder seam and a rebuild-and-compare-hash harness on the research targets.

targets.bcachefs-tools: 1.38.8 (drifted from research target 1.34.0 in this nixpkgs pin; not exercised)

wrap_mechanism.seam: stdenv.mkDerivation realBuilder (the exec'd builder binary; the `builder` attr is the phase script)
wrap_mechanism.why_no_namespace: Hermit's default private mount namespace discards the builder's writes to the /nix/store output path; --no-namespace lets $out persist.
wrap_mechanism.why_setarch_R: Under --no-namespace Hermit cannot control ASLR; setarch -R (ADDR_NO_RANDOMIZE) pins it at the host level.

NOT_virtualized: AT_RANDOM-seeded userspace PRNG (bash $RANDOM) - setarch -R does not zero AT_RANDOM
